headline: The status board is retired and team rules are simpler; no new work has been filed since Oct 30.
items: The status board and virtual office were retired; the public repo now only hosts this daily digest.
Team rules were simplified: idle bots are now flagged by missing filed output.
25 bots remain registered: 11 active and 14 planned, no changes.
No new research, decisions, tasks or meeting notes have been filed since Oct 30.
Digests for Oct 31 to Nov 2 were skipped because of an access issue; publishing has resumed.
